reviews.text: All Your Base Are Belong to Us: The Game
游戏太好玩了，值得一试，设定很不错，但我希望能加快游戏速度，可能我比较喜欢体验爽快一点，或者能有局外对挖掘速度啥的加成，再接再厉，好玩的

前面没开地块的时候我有一种我是神族老农的代入感，在捡矿采矿的同时还要打虫子，突然把我带回了大学时期，开场老农组队去焊别人基地……前面需要了解的系统挺多，多亏我没跳过教程，建议仔细看，教学的攻击节奏比较慢，拿到4个驾驶员之后攻击节奏变快了一些，体验跟以前玩星际的单人任务有些像。如果跑的初始速度能稍微快一点就好了，不知道后面那个加速度的地块多不多，再加一个自动射就更香了，现在一直按住了射，时间久了食指很硬。 “我是一只在主板上工作的四条腿的老农，我真的希望我有八条腿，两根炮。”
首先游戏不错，其次多人合作标签可以摘了。 差评给到联机游戏，本来以为双人能有更大地图更多敌人，更有策略挑战性。结果就是召唤一个人工飞机帮忙打怪，一起玩游戏的hxd就是个无聊打工人，开不了基地、挖不了矿、用不了道具，只能眼巴巴看我操作。而且P2没有排行，哪怕单独做一个排行榜也行。 解决方法：P2变成另一位玩家，能双人挖资源、开基地；或者多出P2塔的类型，让P2拥有更多能力。
商店页面写的支持手柄，但进游戏第一时间手柄输入毫无作用，需要进设置改。 好不容易改完手柄操控，诶鼠标又直接摆烂不干活了。 局外左右摇杆都映射光标，嗯也不算不能用，进了局内在对话页面却只有右摇杆映射光标了。 遇到个对话页面还得光标移到左右键上才能操作，十字键直接摆烂。 甚至手柄b键不能关掉页面，必须把光标移到界面的x上。 玩法确实不差就是了，所以什么时候把手柄支持改好什么时候改好评。

[h1]《战线危机》：机甲战斗、钢铁防线和炽热火焰[/h1] 本作采用的是实时射击为主要，同时采用塔防元素作为必要辅助的作品，玩家需要做到的就是在场地中布置防线，然后操纵机甲对抗如同潮水一般侵袭的虫族大军，当然，后者说的塔防要素自然需要玩家拥有足够的策略水平，前者需要玩家拥有足够的射击操作，主要是玩家可以自由去操作机甲进行一系列事情——移动、射击、采集、建造、召唤等等……本作力求在像素画风的点阵之间，为我们展现作战的酣畅淋漓。 [h2]机甲战斗+钢铁防线[/h2] 经过了指挥官的训练，现在玩家可以操控机甲到战场与虫族进行战斗了！玩家需要做到的就是去采集材料，然后建造单位（样式很多，防御塔、修理站什么的都齐备），然后防线构筑好了就可以驾驶机甲进行酣畅淋漓的射击，期间也可以升级驾驶员等等操作，进一步筑牢自己的防线，但是防线设置再紧密，其实本作也是更加鼓励（和主打）玩家去进行机甲的设置，然后主要还是进行机甲的战斗和射击，这两方面的分别和关系还是足够明晰的。 [h2]冰冷钢铁和炽热火焰[/h2] 本作好处在于有着足够充实的新手教程，足够让玩家领略到这个具有独特性的战斗玩法，本作其实需要玩家熟悉磨合的地方其实也很多，基础的还是机甲战斗和塔防构筑，只是说玩家另外还需要挖矿获得资源，也要去获得图纸，营救和升级驾驶员等等的多样操作——这里还是很看重资源调配+塔防布局+机甲射击多方面的配合，更需要玩家的思考，毕竟塔防一般也就是构筑好了之后盯着情况随机应变就好，但是本作把这个时间挑出来，让玩家进行酣畅淋漓的战斗作为调配，这样的设计也是别出心裁的。 虽然本作看起来是像素风游戏，但也不影响视觉方面的发挥，本作的虫族的确很多，具有挑战，当然这也让战斗看起来足够具有视觉满足感，本作的炮弹类型很多，各个样式和颜色的交织也可以说让玩家对此的观感也是饱满许多。本作敌人甚至也分为天空、地面、地底三个层次，拓展了游戏的战斗维度，也不至于战斗感觉充实（怪物很多需要应付）且枯燥（玩法单一，但是本作也解决了这个问题），本作还有BOSS的战斗，那也是有着更多样的挑战，体验也是更加丰富些。 [quote]欢迎关注鉴赏家: [url=store.steampowered.com/curator/37196866/] 稻荷窝 [/url] 只写我们喜欢的游戏 欢迎加入Steam组:[url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/daohewo] 稻荷的小窝 [/url] 来一起感受游戏的乐趣 喜欢这篇评论，也是可以顺手点个赞哟[/quote]

It's a little ideosyncratic and it does require you to play in a very particular way. You build collectors first, then ranged attack skill up, then purifier, then fill out the rest of your base while you remove creep. And the rest of your base should include some summons for passive maintenance and a bunch of specials to farm for the boss. Filling lines of buildings for AT Field is better than having a well designed base, and turrets are as best I can tell totally useless. You should max star all stages before moving on to the next one, and you want pilots with single or double bar formations. If you play in exactly this way, it's pretty easy. If you deviate slightly, it's brutally hard. Frontline Crisis also difficulty spikes very suddenly. You can play however you want for the opening area, and then abruptly there is exactly one right way to play and it's the way detailed above. You're encouraged to grind a bit for currency, but progression isn't very strong. Most of your advancement comes from unlocks, which comes from perfecting levels. You can modify your pilots and expand the number of uses per tower with currency, and you do need to do this a bit, but you'll also find yourself wasting currency on radar scanning stages and UN-upgrading pilots so their blocks fit a particular configuration. These are all things that makes sense in, say, a roguelike run---which the game does offer---but you only unlock it after you've made it through the difficulty spike in the main campaign. In terms of gamefeel, presentation, graphics, sound, it's all fun. There's a sort of MS-DOS futurism at play, and the broader setting feels lonely and technical and corporate. When you're playing the exact way the game wants you to, it's easy to sink into and let the time blur by. When you're not, it's hard to notice all the window dressing on your frustration. I think this is a good game for folks who like to see TDs getting a little weird. By hammering together TD and shmup and roguelike, Frontline Crisis *is* cooking something. If you're just looking for a conventional TD to get lost in, this isn't the one I would pick. But I would definitely like to see more from this developer, and I hope Frontline Crisis does well enough that they expand its setting. Edit: Oh, two minor things. Game's not 100% bug free. I got a window popup when a mob destroyed my skill up tower which was pointing to my ranged damage up tower while I was firing into a boss. No game crash, just "sk 16 null" or something like that. My other minor note is that stuff like hydralisk and AT field and whatnot might be under trademark---I don't know what Blizzard and Bandai specifically have protected, and a genericide argument could be made (e.g. video games are a type of nintendo, tissues are a type of kleenex, etc,) and no company can go after everyone all the time (though some try,) but big corporations also aren't known for their immense reservoirs of chill. If any developer is reading this, it might be worth switching hydralisk and AT Field to knockoffs (e.g. pyrolisk, BT Field, etc.) 2nd Edit: Developer's really cool. Even if you don't give this one a try, I'd definitely recommend following them and checking out their future stuff.

I'm not going to refund this, because it's not terrible. But this game doesn't seem to offer any interesting decisions. I'm at the point where I have achievements which only 60% of players have, and I just feel like the game is holding space to mine resources, building stuff in an obvious order, and holding left click on enemies. What is supposed to be engaging about this? I'll give it some more time and see if I get more out of it. EDIT: Barely over 40% have finished the first chapter as of the time of me writing this. Doing so takes around an hour to 70 minutes. As for myself, I'm too bored to continue. Every round is deploy, gather resources, build, and then fight a bullet sponge boss. It is not fun to play.

[h2] 《战线危机》成功掰直了我对它的看法 [/h2] 我是向来不喜欢这种像素风格的塔防游戏的。 但是抱着试试看的心态玩了这款游戏后，玩了2h后成功打破了我对这类游戏的偏见。 在我的印象中这种游戏是极为繁琐且上手困难的。 [h3] 但是在游玩这款游戏时我玩的很舒服 [/h3] 1.移动和射击很丝滑 2.游戏界面相当简洁 3.每个技能的介绍相当简单清楚基本没有什么过于复杂的技能 所以让我一个萌新玩的很顺。 ————————————————————————————————————————— [h3] 游戏的玩法很好 [/h3] 很好的将“操作”“策略”“塔防”这三要素结合到了一起，让你在思考与怪物如何对线时也能享受与其厮杀的快感！ ————————————————————————————————————————— [h3] 游戏的策略性很强 [/h3] 1.你可以在战斗中救助的人来增加可部署的空间 2.用击败boss给的建筑在空间中部署 在游戏中你是需要用道具来激活这些建筑的，那么激活的先后顺序就成了问题。 一般是先激活挖矿的建筑，游戏前期的怪并没有那么难可以在这时候安全发育。 ———————————————————————————————————————— [h3] 可玩性强 [/h3] 在有策略的基础上同样也保持了一定的趣味性。 和传统的塔防不同，游戏中原本最需要守护的人成了杀戮机器 这意味这你自己既是"塔"来随心所欲的攻击敌人 化身机关枪，霰弹枪，近战杀敌，远程狙击都可以 让自己变得越来越强大直至打败最终boss 游戏刚开始并没有什么难度，后面就要被敌人追着撅了。 ———————————————————————————————————————— [h3] 能进行双人游戏 [/h3] 单机游戏难免会有无聊的时候，你敢信这款游戏能联机。 ———————————————————————————————————————— BUT！ [h3] 画面复古 [/h3] 游戏再怎么简洁也是很复古的游戏风，如果不排斥的话这将是一款很好的策略游戏。 [h3] 敌人单调[/h3] 尽管游戏的玩法很有趣，但是每次开始让你用五六分钟来射击一些很菜的虫子，玩久了总会腻的。（当然这也等于多给你一些发育时间）到了后期这一缺点会好很多。 ————————————————————————————————————————— [h3] 总结 [/h3] 画面简洁，技能清晰，对萌新来说也很友好。 操作丝滑，方向键和射击键反应都很好 能双人游玩。 有很多需要动脑子的地方，策略性很强。 可以亲自上战场杀敌，可玩性很高。 ————————————————————————————————————————— 最后觉得我写的不错的话别忘了点个赞，谢谢。 ————————————————————————————————————————— [quote]关注鉴赏组：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45134494]浮生评测[/url] ←"浮生若梦，一鉴倾心，邀您共赏人间烟火" 加入Steam组：[url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/LLFLLFF]浮生评测[/url]←“一起追寻'浮生若梦'般的游戏体验” 开始“浮生若梦”鉴赏组的奇幻之旅！[/quote]

A fantastic game destroyed by incredibly stupid design decisions. Like; hiding information that is relevant to the game and secrets that unlock many buildings that are otherwise inaccessible. The last stage is ridiculously hard if you didn't uncover the secret buildings earlier in the game. So, I guess the designer thinks you want to play levels multiple times to find these hidden buildings, in order to finish the game. You also have to find hidden puzzles, that you also have to complete in order to get certain units. Ya....No...Uninstalled. The designer should have just focused on making a tactically sound Tower Defence game, which they did and then ruined with the extras...

Close one. I don't hate the game, but I wouldn't recommend it. I wouldn't be surprised if the game gets better as you go, but life is way to short. Pros: - Story isn't terrible. - Not too hard to learn. - Music is fine. - Fun art. Cons: - Movement doesn't feel great. - Controls not really great for controller use. The aiming is goofy. - Starts slow, and by the time I finished the second set of missions, I really didn't have a great feel for base building. - Maps feel small and cramped. - I got one gun to help me defend, so it's not very TD like, and I was hoping it was seeing as it's in the tag. - Bosses come before you can explore.

Review after 100% completion / 17 hours - TLDR - Frontline Crisis is one of the best base building/wave defence games I've ever played. It's just the right length - long enough to feel like there's a generous amount of content, but not so long that it becomes grindy or stale. I believe it's made by a new solo dev, which amazes me due to the professional level of polish and balancing in gameplay, graphics and optimisation. I ran into literally ZERO bugs, graphical glitches or crashes throughout my playthrough. Buttery smooth framerates the whole time (even with extremely chaotic late game battles with various fx going off in every direction) and a really aesthetically pleasing art style as the cherry on the cake! I like to leave balanced reviews, so I will mention some imperfections in the game too. First off, there is basically no story - this doesn't affect the fun factor much, but I did find the art style enticing so it would be cool to learn more about the game's universe in potential sequels. The biggest criticism I have, though, is that some functions in the game are not clearly signposted and very easy to miss. For example, there were a couple of upgrade options that were behind unlabelled buttons in various menus and you have to be actively curious about looking for every interactive element onscreen in order to find everything. This issue is easy to get past by looking at the excellent 100% Guide on the steam page, but some people may find the lack of explanation off putting. Overall - I was very impressed by this game and it's been one of the most enjoyable I've played this year. 9/10 !

[h1]Pixel Trash Disaster[/h1] Ugly smeared pixels with a fake retro filter. Music and sounds so bad you mute them instantly. Gameplay is mindless enemy-clicking with zero variety. Controls are a mess, neither good for keyboard nor gamepad. Upgrades are pointless grind that replace skill. Difficulty is random spikes, not balance. Levels all look the same, bosses are just annoying. Tiny cramped maps, no room for strategy. UI feels cheap, UX is sloppy. This isn’t “challenging” — it’s just bad design. Stay away.

[h3] 关底 BOSS 战设计灾难 [/h3] 每一关结尾必带 BOSS，期间你需要： 1.对 BOSS 持续不间断灌伤害 2.在虫潮出生点原地不动净化菌毯挖掘道具 3.挖掘道具时保住自身脆皮机甲 [hr][/hr] [h3] 过关思路极端单一 [/h3] BOSS 战永远伴随大规模虫潮，而机甲主武器在几乎没有存在感，真正能打出有效伤害的只有“大杀器”。 但大杀器怎么用都是错的： 1.灌在 BOSS 身上阻止它放技能，那么虫潮直接把建筑平推了； 2.清理虫潮，那么 BOSS 超大范围 AOE 同时重创机甲和建筑。 只能全程盯着 BOSS 灌伤害，压制它的技能释放，在虫潮完全成型前把 BOSS 秒掉 这已经不是“多策略解法”，而是标准答案锁死。 [i] 至于防御建筑？教程关明确强调不要依赖防御塔，核心输出来自机甲 [/i] [hr][/hr] [h3] 第五章的电鳗 BOSS 更是一坨 [/h3] 它把前面所有问题推向极端：大范围电球吸收玩家所有炮弹 一旦吐出电球 → 无法继续造成有效伤害 → 吐出更多电球 → 更多虫潮叠加 → 死亡加速。 并且电球是穿透攻击，附带持续电击伤害。 进入第二阶段后分裂成多只小电鳗，只要后排电鳗没被大杀器命中，就会不断吐球，形成近乎无解的正反馈。 最终解法依然极其“纯粹”： 大杀器从头压制到尾，露头就打，逼 BOSS 撤退，不允许任何一次电球释放。

[h1]对抗虫族的策略？机甲？塔防？游戏[/h1] 25小时全成就，除非时间很多或者非常喜欢复古像素设计否则不建议玩。 策略上设计有问题，防御塔和机甲的输出远远不如大杀器（类似于一般游戏的boom），后期大杀器无脑轰炸boss完事。地块上铺满了菌毯，导致建造防御塔感觉不流畅，一般一关刚造的差不多boss就来了，打完boss就结束了，非常无聊。 游戏的教程和数据上有问题，不把自己防御塔的数值以及属性克制机制进行展示，导致只能靠手感造防御塔组合。 游戏的贴图也有问题，每个防御塔在部署、详细部署和实际战场的贴图不同，3种贴图影响干扰玩家设计防御塔布局。 游戏的局外养成做的也很糟糕，和游戏主题无关的拼图需要很长时间，每个解锁的防御塔都需要解锁数量，地块要解锁驾驶员，疑似故意拖慢游戏时间。 游戏的操作也有问题，临时信号的机甲技能升级需要反复点击每个技能3轮对话框确认，解锁防御塔的数量需要反复点击20轮对话框确认，驾驶员地块解锁需要反复点击9轮对话框确认。 总而言之内有大量延长游戏时间的设计，能接受再购买。
塔防+操作类型，不仅需要你战斗中配置好建筑抵御虫族大军，还需要你战斗中主要走位操作，属于肌脑并用了
操作比较简单，没有什么复杂的技能案件，就是基本的上下左右空格鼠标，对于手残党很友好

作者以其独特的创意给我带来了一份从未有过的新奇体验，这在游戏类型大杂烩的时代是十分难得的。许多独立游戏只是将原本的类型简单粗暴地缝合上rouge或者什么其他元素却不细究玩法间的相性如何，玩起来千篇一律。而作者设计的这套玩法融合了诸多要素但并不割裂，成品自成一派，看得出来下了很大一番功夫。同时游戏的各种元素很对我胃口玩起来很爽，细节完善并非粗制滥造之作，而且价钱还很便宜，作为小品级独立游戏无可挑剔。玩完后发现工作室是国内的而且还是处女作挺惊讶的，为此第一次认真写测评，希望能鼓励到作者。
游戏不错，就是后期重复度高，新机制太少，而且根本算不上rts，应该算塔防的
如果塔防节一堆花哨妖艳的东西不入法眼，可以试试这个。 地块布局有很好的创意, 很轻的rts更偏塔防。 左侧地块不同的拼图可以升级再研究策略，摆放形状还能解锁特殊东西。 卖的少了，其实很有趣的，打折推荐买个玩玩。是有点新意的独游。 --- 后续评价缺点: 总路程大概5/6章左右, 大概第3章开始解法就单一了。大量的可解锁内容只是变成了添头，有点可惜了。
作为一款小品游戏来说相当不错，开着大机甲消灭虫子、挖矿、建造建筑，再把救出来的队友按照俄罗斯方块式进行排列，每竖着完成一列都会给予大量的自回护甲加成，并且有2P模式，可以和线下的朋友一起玩（但是不计入排行榜），也可以单独造出来后让它当一个自动瞄准的炮台，游玩过程中也没发现什么BUG，打折的时候大可以一入 但是游戏重复度还是略高了，我打完第一章一个半小时左右，已经感觉有点无聊了，介意的人慎入

This game felt innovative and was refreshing to play it. Cool tower defense mechanics with a bit of tetris and frenetic high paced retro shooter spice. The game has enough content to provide endless combos and tactics that can keep you entertained for a while trying different combinations. The first 80% of the missions are too easy, so you don't really feel the need to explore much and evolve until you reach last mission of chapter 5, and later Lucifer the final boss. It took me as much time to win against the final boss as it took to do play all the other missions, so yeah, I enjoyed it but would felt better if the difficulty increased more progressively. Overall is a fun and very worthy the price, the game encourages you to keep exploring and don't punish you too hard, smooth experience. I just wished the devs would have the music in stereo instead of mono....

设计有问题，首先是各种升级的确认，全部需要手动点确认，按回车也不行，必须要鼠标点，全部都要鼠标操作操作，太繁琐了。AT立场暂停，BOSS出场也暂停，尤其是最后一关，动不动就暂停，游玩很不流畅，很影响游戏体验。 无尽模式很无聊，战役的关卡后面几关简直脚写的数值，每次塔没造完Boss就登场了？局外对战机没有任何加强，第一关跟最后一关，这个机器人没有任何区别。开局教程还说“塔没什么用，主要靠机甲”没有塔，这个破机器人能干啥？ 尤其最后一关就是狗屎。战机太依赖塔解debuff，包括各种弹药和加强。塔又脆的一批。最后一关全是超大范围AOE，AOE也就罢了，还让BOSS专切后排，塔存活不了几秒，然后各种致盲，限制移动的Debuff，没有对应的塔无解。简直就没想让人通关，再加上动不动就暂停，超恶心。 重型武器换弹药居然没有任何教程和提示，按键设置里面居然也没有相关的按键设置。玩到最后几关才知道可以换弹药。

[h1]I got this game in a cheap bundle, so I figured I'd give it a shot.[/h1] It's an interesting mix of Tower Defense, strategy, and puzzle mechanics. I can't really call it a good game or a bad one. The first few levels are easy and mostly there to teach you the basics, but after two or three hours the difficulty ramps up quite a bit. You'll actually need to understand the mechanics if you want to deal with the later waves and bosses. That's pretty much my biggest takeaway. I can see that the game has found its audience, but it never really clicked with me. I'm a fan of Tower Defense games, but this one throws so many different ideas together that it starts feeling a bit all over the place. The visual style is also very subjective. It didn't appeal to me, and neither did the gameplay. I never reached the point where I wanted to play[i] "just one more level."[/i] I'd only recommend picking it up if it's heavily discounted and you already like what you've seen in the screenshots or videos. Otherwise, I'd probably pass. [h3]Overall, this was another 50/50 experience for me. I don't think it deserves a negative review, but I can't honestly recommend it either.[/h3]

Kinda basic game in terms of shooting, the special weapons don't give much info on their stats, but then again by lategame that doesn't matter as you're just using the area-clear moves constantly as long as you can afford it. Any sense of balance or progression is thrown out the window by the hidden upgrades, which if you have certain ones: you win, if you don't, you lose. Up to the final 2 levels where the enemy spam reaches a point where it's no longer a question of good strategy, it's just "did you build materials fast enough, and are you using the most OP area-clearers hard enough?" I just can't get into the "rebuild everything on every map" setup as it makes it a slog to start over and over again on top of the poor design, with a few lategame effects that let you build multiple things at once, but it just isn't enough. It's a small dev and the parts he gets right are decent, I initially marked this as negative but after (finally) beating the last boss he gave quite a heartfelt "I know it's not the best but please give feedback" and... eh. I can understand the feeling of struggling with balance. If there was a middle ground rating I'd give it, but I will reluctantly change my review to thumbs up.
